object_description: large-scale activating structure within a transformed park landscape
design_condition: The proposal relocates most building functions to free the existing school site as a large recreational landscape, using tree canopy, clearings, and retained building traces to create varied outdoor places.

positive.statement: The proposal offers a valuable holistic urban-planning response to the district’s densification pressure.
Freeing the existing site as a large recreational area would create substantial added value for the neighbourhood.
The transformed landscape creates varied specific places with a high quality of stay.
The alternation between emptiness and green volumes is atmospheric and essential to the garden-city character.

negative.statement: Integrating the all-weather pitches into the enclosure is unrealistic at the project’s advanced stage.
The tight circulation spaces cannot meet the requirements for meeting and lounge areas.
The proposed type cannot provide the required clusters of three to four classes.
Classrooms facing narrow and poorly lit spaces would have cramped conditions and reduced quality.
The required kindergartens are not identified in the project.
